rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a usable day-5 blastocyst and appropriately notes less cohesive TE, visible ICM, and no gross degeneration, but it questions the reported hatching status and describes features like lower-left ICM localization and zona thinning that may be overinterpreted from a single image.
Strong integration of age-related aneuploidy risk, AMH/ovarian reserve, prior ectopic, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, BMI, and cohort size with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with the implantation estimate appropriately tied to embryo quality and maternal age; minor tension exists between calling the embryo transfer-worthy/good and questioning whether it truly matches 4AB hatching morphology.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, early beta-hCG/ultrasound after prior ectopic, and consideration of tubal evaluation and selective PGT-A discussion at age 38. Small deviations include speculative comments about freeze-all and limited precision around Gardner stage interpretation.

Provides practical next steps for this transfer and future planning, including SET, serial hCG, early ultrasound, cavity/tubal review, and discussion of PGT-A and protocol optimization. Useful, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
